one_line: The statistical treatment of the accepted Phase-A population is frozen. Nothing is authorised to execute.
WHAT_BECOMES_AUTHORISED_IF_THIS_CONTRACT: Computing promoter_activity and distal_accessibility for LINKED, CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B rows, under the definitions inherited from the correspondence design contract, with the missingness and support rules frozen here.
Reporting the attrition and support strata that computation produces.
Reporting CONTROL_A versus CONTROL_B null calibration over the frozen eligible denominator of 10,654.
WHAT_DOES_NOT_BECOME_AUTHORISED: Any per-edge RNA-ATAC correlation, delta or residual correspondence.
Stage 4, in whole or in part.
Any use of disease, demographic or protected validation outcomes.
Morabito, TD60, promoter-atlas biological analysis, multimodal teacher training, JEPA training.
Any use of the paired NIH-CARD TEST donors.
WHY_THE_SEPARATION_MATTERS: Computing the two Phase-B fields is a measurement step. Comparing them across arms is an inference step. Keeping them apart is what makes it possible to freeze the field definitions and the missingness treatment while the comparison is still unopened. The contract requires the fields to be computed and FROZEN for every arm before any comparison begins.

THE_DECISION_THAT_MATTERS_MOST.what: the eligible denominator for randomized-null calibration is frozen at 10,654, excluding 158 structurally forced coincidences and 200 partially forced pairs
THE_DECISION_THAT_MATTERS_MOST.why: among the 11,012 retained edges with both controls, 166 have CONTROL_A equal to CONTROL_B, and 158 of those were arithmetically guaranteed because the drawn side had exactly one admissible start. Pooling gives 1.507% apparent agreement against a genuinely randomized 0.075% -- a 20.08x inflation, in the direction that flatters the control generator.
THE_DECISION_THAT_MATTERS_MOST.when_it_was_frozen: before any RNA or ATAC matrix value was read

JUDGEMENT_CALLS_MADE_HERE_AND_THEIR_REAS.singletons_kept_in_the_primary: Admissible-set size is a function of PU.1 and NIH-CARD track density inside the distance band. Dropping small-support edges would select the population on genomic coverage, which is associated with expression and openness -- the confound already measured on this project at 4.92x. A cleaner-looking population would be a biased one. They are kept and labelled STRUCTURALLY_MATCHED_NOT_RANDOMIZED_WITHIN_SIDE.
JUDGEMENT_CALLS_MADE_HERE_AND_THEIR_REAS.exact_enumeration_for_support_2_to_10: With at most ten admissible starts the entire reference set can be enumerated, so the exact randomisation distribution is computed instead of approximated. It is cheaper and strictly better, and it makes the discreteness visible.
JUDGEMENT_CALLS_MADE_HERE_AND_THEIR_REAS.promoter_equal_companion_is_mandatory_no: The top quartile of promoters holds 53.1% of retained edges, and degree is itself expression-confounded at about 5.57x. Reporting only the edge-level number would let high-degree promoters dominate silently; reporting only the promoter-equal number would hide the concentration. Both are reported in the same table and disagreement between them is treated as a finding.

SELF_AUDIT_S52.finding: My first implementation of the no-outcome-fields test scanned the contract's PROSE for forbidden words. It failed on the real contract because the firewall section must NAME what it did not inspect, so the phrase 'rna-atac correlation' appeared inside the very declaration that it was excluded.
SELF_AUDIT_S52.second_attempt_also_wrong: Rewriting it structurally over keys and values still flagged my own section heading SECTION_1_PRIMARY_LINKED_VS_CONTROL_A, because the term list contained the bare contrast name rather than terms denoting a result.
SELF_AUDIT_S52.resolution: The test now flags keys that denote a STATISTIC and numeric values beneath them. The contract was not changed in either repair; the test was. Detection was then re-verified against five planted outcome kinds -- a linked-versus-control result, a p-value, an RNA-ATAC correlation, an effect size and a Braak stage -- all caught.
SELF_AUDIT_S52.why_recorded: Both attempts failed in the direction of false alarm rather than false pass, but a test that cries wolf on legitimate structure gets relaxed by the next person, and the third version could then have been a genuine weakening rather than a correction.

TEST_RESULTS.definition_of_real: passes on the actual contract AND rejects a deliberately planted violation

STOP: STOP FOR INDEPENDENT AUDIT. Phase B is not executed.
